description: This file is a shell script used for testing and diagnosing network connectivity issues such as ping tests, DNS resolution, and device rebooting. It incorporates configuration reads and conditional actions to attempt self-healing of network problems.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current corrective action state from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay before starting the ping test.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router by invoking the device control command.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Checks if a reset is needed for specific processes and triggers a router reboot if necessary.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS ping test and takes corrective action if needed.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs a network ping test to the default gateway and may trigger a reset on failure.
